data.long_meaning: A motor vehicle or any wheeled conveyance designed for transporting passengers or goods. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Car usually hope their child will grow to embody vehicle, conveyance and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Car" is synonymous with progress, independence, and modernity in the Western world. It symbolizes the pursuit of a better life through mobility, as seen in hit songs like 'Little Deuce Coupe' by the Beach Boys and 'Car Radio' by Twenty One Pilots. Cars have reshaped urban landscapes, enabled globalization, and became a popular subject in art, literature, and media.
data.spiritual_significance: The Christian name 'Car' can be seen as a metaphor for Christian life's spiritual journey. In the Old Testament, God led His people in a 'car' (Ark) during the flood to save them from destruction. In the New Testament, Christ equates Himself to a 'living Water' who satiates the human soul's thirst for God. In applying this metaphor, saying "Call me Car" could signify "Call me the vehicle of God that leads you to spiritual fulfillment" or "Call me the means by which God saves you from spiritual destruction." Take a ride with me, your spiritual Car, and let us embark on this meaningful and eternal journey towards God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Vehicle, conveyance" symbolizes A motor vehicle or any wheeled conveyance designed for transporting passengers or goods.. In Christian spirituality, bearing the name Car serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual calling and connection to Christian values of vehicle, conveyance.
